∀ {R : Type} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {S : Type} [inst_4 : CommRing S] {φ : R →+* S} {a : S}
  [inst_7 : UniformSpace R] [inst_8 : UniformSpace S] [inst_9 : IsUniformAddGroup R]
  [inst_10 : IsTopologicalSemiring R] [inst_11 : IsUniformAddGroup S] [inst_12 : T2Space S]
  [inst_13 : CompleteSpace S] [inst_14 : IsTopologicalRing S]
  [inst_15 : IsLinearTopology S S],
  Continuous ⇑φ →
    PowerSeries.HasEval a →
      ∀ {u : S},
        PowerSeries.HasEval u →
          ∀ {v : S},
            Commute u v → UniformContinuous fun x ↦ PowerSeries.eval₂ φ (u * v) x + v

∀ {F : Type} [inst_2 : Field F] {E : Type} [inst_4 : Field E] [inst_5 : Algebra F E]
  {H1 H2 : Subgroup Gal(E/F)},
  H1 ≤ H2 →
    ∀ {u : Set (IntermediateField F E)},
      IntermediateField.fixedField H2 ∈ upperBounds u →
        IsLUB (upperBounds u) (IntermediateField.fixedField H1) →
          ∀ {v : Filter (IntermediateField F E)},
            Set.Iio (IntermediateField.fixedField H1) ≤ᶠ[v] ⋃ x ∈ upperBounds u, Set.Iio x

∀ {R : Type} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {τ : Type} {f : MvPowerSeries τ R} {φ : PowerSeries R},
  MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0 →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff φ = 0 →
      ∀ (u : ℕ),
        IsUnit ((PowerSeries.subst f φ).order \ f.order) →
          ((PowerSeries.monomial u)
                (symmDiff (PowerSeries.subst f φ).order f.order)).order =
            ↑u

∀ {F E : Type} (E' : Type) [inst_4 : Field F] [inst_5 : Field E] [inst_6 : Field E']
  [inst_7 : Algebra F E] [inst_8 : Algebra F E'] [inst_9 : Algebra E E']
  [inst_10 : IsScalarTower F E E'] (L : IntermediateField F E) [inst_12 : Normal F E]
  [inst_13 : Normal F E'] {u : ℕ},
  IsRelPrime u
      (IntermediateField.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F E E') L).fixingSubgroup.index →
    ∀ {v : ℕ},
      u ∣ v * L.fixingSubgroup.index →
        IsPrimal u →
          gcd L.fixingSubgroup.index u ∣
            gcd
              (IntermediateField.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F E E') L).fixingSubgroup.index
              v

∀ {R : Type} (A : Type) [inst_3 : CommSemiring R] [inst_4 : CommSemiring A]
  [inst_5 : Algebra R A] (f : PowerSeries R) {u : ℕ},
  u ≠ 0 →
    IsUnit ((PowerSeries.map (algebraMap R A)) f ^ u) →
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff ((algebraMap (PowerSeries R) (PowerSeries A)) f) ∈
        nonZeroDivisors A

∀ {F E : Type} (E' : Type) [inst_4 : Field F] [inst_5 : Field E] [inst_6 : Field E']
  [inst_7 : Algebra F E] [inst_8 : Algebra F E'] [inst_9 : Algebra E E']
  [inst_10 : IsScalarTower F E E'] (L : IntermediateField F E) [inst_12 : Normal F E]
  [inst_13 : Normal F E'] {u : ℕ} {v w : ℕ∞},
  Set.Ioc v (emultiplicity L.fixingSubgroup.index u) ≠ ⊥ →
    ∀ {a : Set ℕ∞},
      {a} ≠
        {Set.Ioc
            (emultiplicity
              (IntermediateField.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F E E') L).fixingSubgroup.index
              u)
            w,
          ⊤}

∀ {R : Type} (A : Type) [inst_3 : CommSemiring R] [inst_4 : CommSemiring A]
  [inst_5 : Algebra R A] (p : Polynomial R) {u : PowerSeries A},
  IsRelPrime u ((algebraMap (Polynomial R) (PowerSeries A)) p) →
    u ∣ (PowerSeries.map (algebraMap R A)) ↑p →
      ∀ (v : Polynomial A),
        v.degree ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.C (PowerSeries.constantCoeff u) * v).degree ≠ 0

∀ {F : Type} [inst_2 : Field F] {E : Type} [inst_4 : Field E] [inst_5 : Algebra F E]
  {H1 H2 : Subgroup Gal(E/F)},
  H1 ≤ H2 →
    ∀ {u : ℕ},
      u ≠ 0 →
        ∀ {v w : ℕ},
          v ≡ w [MOD (IntermediateField.fixedField H1).fixingSubgroup.index ^ u] →
            v ≡ w [MOD
              (IntermediateField.fixedField H1).fixingSubgroup.relIndex
                (IntermediateField.fixedField H2).fixingSubgroup]

∀ {R : Type} [inst_2 : Semiring R] (φ : PowerSeries R),
  IsUnit φ →
    ∀ {u v : R},
      u * PowerSeries.constantCoeff φ = v * PowerSeries.constantCoeff φ →
        v ≠ 0 → ∀ (w : ℕ), Associated ((PowerSeries.monomial w) u).order ↑w

∀ {R : Type} [inst_2 : Semiring R] (φ : PowerSeries R) (n : ℕ),
  (∀ i < n, (PowerSeries.coeff i) φ = 0) →
    IsRelPrime (φ.order - ↑n + ↑n) φ.order →
      Associated ((PowerSeries.monomial n) (φ.order - ↑n + ↑n)).order ↑n

∀ {α β : Type} {f : α → β},
  Function.Bijective f →
    ∀ (b : β) {u : β → β},
      Function.IsConstOn u (f '' {x | f x = b}) → Function.IsConstOn (u ∘ f) {x | f x = b}

∀ {α β : Type} {f : α → β},
  Function.Bijective f →
    ∀ (b : β) {u : β → β},
      Function.IsConstOn u (f '' {x | f x = b}) →
        ∀ {v : α → β}, Set.EqOn (u ∘ f) v {x | f x = b} → Function.IsConstOn v {x | f x = b}

∀ {α β : Type} {f : α → β},
  Function.Bijective f →
    ∀ (b : β) {u : Set β},
      Set.MapsTo f {x | f x = b} u →
        Set.SurjOn f {x | f x = b} u →
          ∀ {v : β → β}, Function.IsConstOn v u → Function.IsConstOn (v ∘ f) {x | f x = b}

∀ {F : Type} [inst_2 : Field F] {E : Type} [inst_4 : Field E] [inst_5 : Algebra F E]
  {K1 K2 : IntermediateField F E},
  K1 ≤ K2 →
    ∀ (u : Subgroup Gal(E/F)),
      K2.fixingSubgroup.relIndex u ∣ K1.fixingSubgroup.relIndex u →
        ∀ {v : ℕ}, K2.fixingSubgroup.relIndex u ∣ᵣ v → K1.fixingSubgroup.relIndex u ∣ᵣ v * v

∀ {F : Type} [inst_2 : Field F] {E : Type} [inst_4 : Field E] [inst_5 : Algebra F E]
  {K1 K2 : IntermediateField F E},
  K1 ≤ K2 →
    ∀ {u : Set (IntermediateField F E)},
      {IntermediateField.fixedField K1.fixingSubgroup,
            IntermediateField.fixedField K2.fixingSubgroup} ⊂
          u →
        ∀ (v : Matroid (IntermediateField F E)),
          {v.restrict
                (Set.Icc (IntermediateField.fixedField K1.fixingSubgroup)
                    (IntermediateField.fixedField K2.fixingSubgroup) \
                  Set.Ioo (IntermediateField.fixedField K1.fixingSubgroup)
                    (IntermediateField.fixedField K2.fixingSubgroup)),
              v.restrict u}.Nontrivial
